verdict.rationale: Vanta's SDK docs state its Auditor API SDKs are generated from an OpenAPI specification, so a spec exists internally. Nothing documents a public download, and probes of common paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The llms.txt and per-page markdown docs are machine-readable, but they are not an API spec. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec URL; spec coverage beyond the Auditor API (e.g. the Manage Vanta API); independent confirmation that the spec can be retrieved.
